chunks.text: Project Aster uses the Flux-7 assay.
The Flux-7 assay measures marker Kappa.
Marker Kappa is produced by gland Nera.
Project Boreal does not use the Flux-7 assay. Project Boreal uses the Vega-2 assay.
The Vega-2 assay measures marker Sigma.
Marker Sigma is produced by gland Luma.
Gland Nera and gland Luma are listed in the site directory. The directory states no production relationship.
Project Cedar is a proposed project. No assay has been assigned to Project Cedar.
